label: Taking isotretinoin (Accutane), or stopped less than 6 months ago
note: Isotretinoin makes skin tear easily. Wait until you've been off it for at least 6 months.

label: Using a retinoid on this area (retinol, tretinoin, adapalene)
note: Pause it for at least a week before sugaring that area.

label: Sunburn, rash, cuts, or irritation in the area
note: Wait until it has fully healed.

label: Chemical peel, laser, or microdermabrasion there in the last 2 weeks
note: Give the skin at least 2 weeks to recover first.

label: Moles, warts, skin tags, cold sores, or varicose veins in the area
note: Work around them. Never put paste over them.

label: Diabetes, poor circulation, or taking blood thinners
note: Ask your doctor first. Skin may bruise more easily and heal more slowly.

label: Hair is shorter than a grain of rice (about 6 mm)
note: Wait a few more days. The paste can't grip short hair, so it pulls skin instead.

label: Hair is longer than about 1.5 cm
note: Trim it to about 6 mm first so it doesn't tangle and snap.

label: Pregnant
note: Skin can be more sensitive. Try a small patch first.

label: First time sugaring, or doing the bikini area
note: Start with an easy area like the lower leg. For the bikini area, consider a professional the first time.

label: Your period is due in the next few days
note: Skin is often more sensitive then. Sugaring a week later may hurt less.
